live.title: Row live with accurate metrics
live.body: Stream stroke-by-stroke power, pace, and heart rate while you row.

track.title: Track pace and stroke rate
track.body: See split times, stroke rate, distance, and split deltas as you go.

review.title: Save and review your performance
review.body: Every row is saved on your device as a FIT file, so you can compare and share.
